foreignObject.div:
“Notice how the apple appears larger than the orange: in your reference, they’re similar sizes.”
+ visual overlays

Figure 1. Overview of Paintwise. (a) Pretrained vision models parse the reference image: SAM 2.1 segments it, CLIP labels each segment and merges fragments into the forms an artist would see, Depth Anything V2 estimates depth, and PiDiNet extracts edges, from which a pencil sketch is drawn. (b) A prominence score orders the regions the way an artist paints them, large anchoring forms first, rather than back to front by depth. (c) A two-phase painter turns the ordered regions into steps: a value block-in, then detail matching. (d) Each attempt is critiqued against its reference step on proportions, perspective and lighting, as guided observation.
